title: The cut's pre-flight does not refuse a known-defects page titled for another release
body:
Found by cc on 2026-11-26, while it prepared the 3.5.6 re-drive. vc read the tags.

What is broken: releasing.md step 2 says to re-drive `docs/known-defects.md` whole and to retitle it for the release before the cut. Nothing checks that it was done. Three cuts shipped the page titled for an older release:

- v3.2.0 ships "Known defects in v3.1.0".
- v3.5.3 ships "Known defects in v3.5.2".
- v3.5.5 ships "Known defects in v3.5.4".

What it costs: a reader of the tag reads defects that were driven against another build, on a page that says it describes this release.

The fix, size XS, owner dc: `bin/.devbin/cut/preflight` refuses a cut when the page's H1 does not name the version being cut. The file is Intent's own (devbin's manifest does not list `bin/.devbin/cut/`), so the fix needs no devbin release. The tree as it is now is the red: the page reads v3.5.4, and the next cut is v3.5.6. cc's 3.5.6 re-drive makes it green.

Scope: hv decides whether it rides 3.5.6. It is a new guard during a release, which hv's rule for releases forbids, and a found issue is not deferred without hv's word.
